shots.scenario: At a kitchen high chair, Bubbles glares into the camera with arms crossed, a tiny empty bowl in front of him.
dialogue: Per my last cry, I would like a snack.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits upright on the couch facing the camera like an interviewer, a toy clipboard in his lap.
dialogue: Dad. Solid effort. Needs improvement at bedtime.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a small table with a toy microphone in front of his mouth, speaking straight to camera.
dialogue: Welcome to the podcast. Today: why bath time is a hostile takeover.

shots.scenario: Bubbles lies propped on pillows in a crib, rubbing one eye, looking into the camera with tired dignity.
dialogue: Five stars for naps. Zero stars for waking up.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits on a rug facing the camera with a deadpan stare, like a stand-up comedian under a warm spotlight.
dialogue: They took a thousand photos of me. I approved none.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in his crib in pajamas under a dim night light, arms folded, staring into the camera.
dialogue: Due to restructuring, bedtime has been moved to never.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits on the edge of his bed in pajamas with a flat expression, staring directly into the camera.
dialogue: I am not crying. I am quiet quitting bedtime.

shots.scenario: Bubbles holds a rice cracker in one tiny fist and points to it while looking into the camera, serious as a negotiator.
dialogue: I work for snacks. Please review my compensation package.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in a baby bathtub with foam on his hair, giving the camera a deadpan look.
dialogue: This bath could have been a wipe.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in a high chair holding a toy phone to his ear, frowning into the camera.
dialogue: I would like to speak to the manager of bedtime.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits on a play mat holding a rattle, looking into the camera with a bewildered stare.
dialogue: Day one. They gave me a rattle and no direction.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits in a car seat in his blazer, holds out a teething ring toward the camera with a tired stare.
dialogue: It is Monday. Please hold my teething ring.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at a table with half a banana in front of him and a toy receipt, looking seriously into the camera.
dialogue: I need to expense one banana. Strictly business.

shots.scenario: Bubbles sits at the head of a tiny table with toy blocks, banging a toy gavel and looking into the camera.
dialogue: Is this the meeting? Great. Meeting adjourned.

shots.scenario: Bubbles stands at a bathroom doorway in his blazer, hands behind his back, looking into the camera with innocent calm.
dialogue: Dad's phone fell in the toilet? I only supervise.
